name: Slop Tower Defense!
creator: Slop TD!
redeem: Launch Slop Tower Defense! on Roblox and make sure you have at least 10 wins.
Click the Settings cog on the left side of the screen.
Scroll to the bottom of the Settings menu to reach the code box.
Type or paste the code exactly as written, including spaces, and press Redeem.
notes:
Slop Tower Defense! is a meme-themed tower defense game from the Slop TD! group. You summon and craft units made of internet slop, place them along the path, and upgrade them to hold back waves of enemies. Winning matches earns Cash, Gems and event currencies such as Stars, Suns and Sheckles, which feed back into more summons and stronger crafts, and themed updates like the Backrooms event add new stages and units.

Codes give Gems, Cash, Stars and sometimes a specific unit, and they can only be used once you have 10 wins. The developers release them for visit, player-count and community server milestones and alongside updates or data wipes, and they post codes, leaks and news in the community Discord.

faq.q: Do you need anything before redeeming Slop Tower Defense! codes?
faq.a: Yes: you need at least 10 wins before the game accepts any code. Play a few matches first, then redeem.

faq.q: Where does Slop Tower Defense! post new codes?
faq.a: The game's description sends players to its community server, the Slop TD! Discord, for codes, leaks and news. New codes usually come with visit, player-count and community server milestones, and with updates or data wipes.

faq.q: Do spaces matter when typing a Slop Tower Defense! code?
faq.a: Yes. Some reported codes, such as DATA WIPE 3, contain spaces. Type or paste each code exactly as written, spaces included, then press Redeem in the Settings menu.

faq.q: What are the Gems, Cash and Stars from codes used for?
faq.a: Cash, Gems and event currencies like Stars pay for more summons and stronger crafts, which build a better unit lineup. Some codes give you a specific unit directly instead.

tips: Place your first units where the path bends or loops. Units there can hit enemies for longer, which helps a lot on early waves.
Check what you can craft before you get rid of extra units. Spare slop from summons may be exactly what a stronger craft needs.
Upgrade a few good units instead of filling the map with weak ones. Strong upgraded units hold the later waves much better.
Play themed events like the Backrooms while they are live. Event currencies such as Stars, Suns and Sheckles come from those events.
useRewards: SLOP is the working code and gives 900 Cash, a small push toward your next summons. Older codes have given Gems, Stars or a specific unit, and they tend to come with milestones and data wipes. When a code hands you a unit, try it in a match before you spend more on summons, so you know if it fills a gap in your lineup.
